why.zh: 从真实页面录下的操作演示：容量 2 时 AB–C 怎样被挡住、诊断栏怎样区分不可能 / 卡住 / 非最优、改节点大小的效果，再在浏览器里写完 report() 和 classify() 并通过全部检查。
why.en: Recorded from the real page: how AB–C is blocked at capacity 2, how the diagnosis tells impossible, stuck and not optimal apart, what changing a node's size does, then writing report() and classify() in the browser and passing every check.
